item.title: Thread: Scale Tool
item.description: What can a single number mean when it is compared, without false equivalence, across quantities such as time, distance, mass, energy, information, and temperature? A React and TypeScript explorer in which one editable decimal value drives source-backed comparisons across nine distinct units. It keeps estimates, models, theory, and unknown quantities explicitly separate from measurements.
